description:
Returns a subscription link for a tier, which the user opens in a
browser. Works without signing in or an API key. The tool itself takes no
payment: the user signs in, accepts the Terms of Service and pays on
Stripe's hosted checkout page.

Standard does not include access to this server's research tools; Pro and
Elite do. After payment, a connection that signs in with OAuth (as
Claude's connectors do) reaches the research tools once the user signs in
with the same account. A client that connects with an API key instead gets
one through a pairing code on the account page (see
`rayana_ai_complete_setup`).
name: rayana_ai_start_checkout

outputSchema.description:
What an agent hands its human to subscribe. Deliberately NOT a Stripe
Checkout URL: this link lands on a Rayana page that signs the human in,
takes their assent to the Terms, and only then starts Stripe's own hosted
Checkout. See api/mcp_server.py's `rayana_ai_start_checkout` for why the
indirection is the point rather than an extra hop.
outputSchema.title: CheckoutHandoff

title: Start a subscription
